summary: Examples show a plain string is not vault-encrypted and a $ANSIBLE_VAULT string is.
questions: What does a vault-encrypted string look like for the test?

answer_card.title: vault_encrypted test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
thisisfalse: '{{ "any string" is vault_encrypted }}'
thisistrue: '{{ "$ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.2;AES256;dev...." is vault_encrypted }}'
```
